label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf) is a True Positive. Although the code validates the resolved IP using InetAddress.getByName(), the subsequent check (isLoopbackAddress || isSiteLocalAddress) is insufficient. In Java, isSiteLocalAddress() primarily identifies Link-Local (169.254.x.x) and IPv6 ULAs, not standard RFC 1918 private ranges (10.x.x.x, 172.16.x.x, 192.168.x.x). An attacker can supply a private IP address (e.g., 10.0.0.1) which passes the validation check, resulting in the resolved sink value being http://<private_ip>/api, enabling Server-Side Request Forgery.

evidence.note: User input flows into target, validated via InetAddress but insufficiently checked for private ranges before URL construction at L24.
